messages:
anna_pm: Heads-up thread for tomorrow's partner minimal metering soft-launch at 10:00 PT. I'm calling out a couple of weird cases we should watch: timezone skew in partner timestamps, partial invoice credits, and batched-offline resends. Keep posts short.

li_dev: Added a consumer change: we now normalize partner timestamps to UTC and drop sub-second precision. Deployed to canary. SQL check I used: `select count(*) from raw_events where abs(extract(epoch from received_ts - partner_ts)) > 3600;` -> 0 on canary sample.

tim_ops: Monitoring note: created alert `partner-timestamp-drift > 30m` and `batched-replay-size > 10k`. Also added a dashboard row showing histogram of partner-ts vs received-ts.

nina_partner: We'll send 4 test batches: 1 realtime, 2 offline batched (1k and 12k events), and 1 partial-refund flow (invoice_refund=true). We'll include `original_invoice_id` for refunds.

li_dev: Refund handling clarified: consumer will accept `original_invoice_id` and emit a negative units record into billing-prep. Edge: if partner sends refund without original, we tag as "manual-review".

recon-bot: preflight-check: schema OK. required fields present: sku, units, invoice_id, timestamp, signature. sample-payload:
```
{"partner_sku":"hw-lite-01","invoice_id":"inv-2660-01","units":10,"timestamp":"2026-03-22T17:05:00Z","signature":"sig.."}
```

li_dev: One more edge: partner uses local midnight charging and will send a daily batch labeled with prior-day's date. Our ETL uses event timestamp; make sure recon aligns on billing-window semantics. Added `billing_date` field mapping in transform.

anna_pm: Operational decision: reconciliation will use two keys: event_timestamp (for usage attribution) and invoice_date (for billing period). Reconciler config: window=24h aligned to partner's billing_date where present.

kate_ops: Reconciliation run schedule proposal: first-pass at +3h (fast delta-only), full-run at +12h, daily thereafter for 7 days. Also enabling "accept-late-arrival" path with 72h backfill and a sticky audit tag `late_arrival=true`.

nina_partner: Quick Q: when we resend big offline batch (12k), will you accept duplicate invoice_ids? We plan each batch to have unique invoice_id but duplicate events can happen on replay.

li_dev: We dedupe by invoice_id + line_item_hash. If duplicates within 1h window, they're dropped. If duplicate after >1h, recon flags for manual review by billing. Documented here: https://rwd.internal/ops/partner-ingest#dedupe.

tim_ops: Safety net: rate-limit large replays to 5k/min with bursting to 10k for 2 mins. We'll throttle, and partner will get 429 with `Retry-After`.

anna_pm: What about signature schema? partner mentioned older SDK might omit header `X-Signature-Version`.

recon-bot: signature-policy: accept v1 and v2. If header missing, try v1; if validation fails, tag `signature_mismatch`. Alert when mismatch_rate > 0.5% in first 6h.

li_dev: I've pushed a small consumer tweak: when signature_mismatch -> store raw payload to `bad_signatures` bucket for offline inspection and surface 10 random samples to the partner channel every hour.

kate_ops: Action: I'll be primary on-call during launch window. If bad_signatures > 50 in 30m or ingestion-lag > 120s, escalate to @anna_pm and @li_dev.

nina_partner: We'll rotate keys at T+24h. Can you tolerate 48h grace for previous key?

li_dev: We can allow 30m overlap today, but we'll need a longer rotation plan for scheduled rotation. Let's collect key-rotation plan after soft-launch and agree on policy.

anna_pm: Final preflight checklist (short): 1) canary normalization OK, 2) refund path handled, 3) dedupe + replay throttles in place, 4) signature fallback ok, 5) recon schedule set. Reply with :white_check_mark: when done.

li_dev: :white_check_mark:

tim_ops: :white_check_mark:

kate_ops: :white_check_mark:

nina_partner: :white_check_mark: will send first test at 09:30 PT.

anna_pm: Great. I'll post GO channel msg at T-10 and T-1. Keep any problems here.
